The 1966–67 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 33rd season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[Association football|football]] in [[Portugal]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship.
